info.title: Fenergo Nebula Authorization Command
info.description:
**Authorization Command API**:
Authorization Command API provides methods related to the user authorization. Use the Authorization Command API to create and manage teams and user-team assignments. Use the Query API to retrieve created aggregates and user profiles.
**Authorization Command API provides**:
  • The ability to create, update and delete Teams.
  • The ability to create, update and delete Access Layers.
  • The ability to create, update and delete Dynamic Access Layer Configurations.
  • The ability to update Related Party Access Layers Inheritance Configuration.
  • The ability to assign/remove user to the team.
  • The ability to assign/unassign user to/from the access layer.
  • The ability to bulk assign/remove user to teams.
